sections.heading: Proposal Summary
sections.text: This proposal, SYN-SYNCP000110-P1, was presented by PFIZER (the Supplier) to Silver Oak Medical Group 110 on October 19, 2025.

sections.heading: Supplier Concession
sections.text: Supplier concession: a Tier 2 rebate of 3.5%.

sections.heading: Supplier Request
sections.text: Supplier request: a Pneumococcal share floor of 75%.

sections.heading: Proposal Status
sections.text: Status of this proposal: countered by the Customer.
